dataset_name: Transaction unique identifier and INSPIRE ID Look Up Table dataset

evidence_slices.fact: Dataset links HM Land Registry Transaction unique identifier from Price Paid data to INSPIRE ID for freehold registered property; identifiers together allow joining datasets; OGL; monthly current CSV link.
Transaction unique identifier is unique per published sale; INSPIRE_ID is the unique polygon identifier; lookup consists of those two identifiers.
Lookup contains primary identifiers from Price Paid and INSPIRE Index Polygons and enables joins that geolocate price-paid records; INSPIRE_ID equals POLY_ID in National Polygon Dataset.
Transaction unique identifier is a mandatory 38-character identifier; INSPIRE ID is a mandatory up-to-9-digit identifier.
Dataset is CSV UTF-8 and file naming pattern is pp-inspire-id-lookup-<month>-<year>.csv.

guardrails: No Transaction unique identifier value was invented.
No polygon geometry or canonical parcel match was inferred.
The exact public CSV link target is preserved even though row bytes were not materialized.
